segmentation.text: The driver of a vehicle
approaching an intersection
shall yield the right-of-way
to a vehicle which has entered the intersection from a different highway.
Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4],
this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices
or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions,
when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to
or is making a left turn.

elements.justification: 'vehicle' is admitted as DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion (DEF-NRS-484A-080).

'approaching an intersection': x occupies (rel.occupies) a carrier of kind st.travel_region whose entrance end is the intersection (st.lane_enters 'the carrier is an approach to that intersection'); the yield is decided at the observation at which x enters it (drv.motion.entering_region 'its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before'), where x still occupies that approach carrier. st.lane_enters is not a stand-in for the subject's presence in the intersection, which rel.occupies reads.

'yield the right-of-way' (DEF-NRS-484A-210 'the right ... to proceed in a lawful manner in preference to another vehicle'): x does not enter the intersection (drv.motion.entering_region over rel.occupies) while a vehicle owed precedence is in it.

'a vehicle' is the admitted aggregate. 'which has entered the intersection' is y's footprint overlapping the intersection (rel.occupies 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region') at every observation since its latest entry into it (drv.motion.entering_region 'its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before'), read through a past operator from x's entry. 'from a different highway' is the carrier c2 (st.travel_region) y occupied at that entry, whose entrance end is the intersection (st.lane_enters 'the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end'), lying on a st.highway ('the entire public way between its boundary lines') through st.on_way ('the public way ... a structure region lies on') on which x's approach carrier does not lie. The intersection lies on every way that meets there, so the way is read from the carriers, never the intersection; st.lane_enters is not a stand-in for presence in the intersection, which rel.occupies reads.

'official traffic-control devices' (DEF-NRS-484A-145 'every sign, signal, marking and device ... for the purpose of regulating, warning or guiding traffic') that control the intersection: a dev.traffic_signal, dev.stop_sign ('regulatory sign requiring a full halt') or dev.yield_sign ('regulatory sign requiring yielding') governing the intersection or x's approach carrier (dev.governs 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls ... or an intersection'). dev.governs is not a stand-in for a position.

'approaching each other from opposite directions': read, as rel.oncoming's contract directs, through the carriers they approach through: x's approach carrier and the carrier y occupied at its latest entry into the intersection (drv.motion.entering_region, rel.occupies, st.lane_enters) have opposed designated directions (drv.road.opposed_directions 'the dot product of their designated directions ... is below minus opposed_cosine'). rel.oncoming is not used: a turn makes current headings cease to be opposed while the approach direction is unchanged.

'is making a left turn': the vehicle's heading change since it entered the intersection (drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry 'the signed heading change of road user x since its footprint last began to overlap region r, in degrees, left positive', integrated from kin.yaw_rate) is at least the turn recognition angle; the concept is not a turn by itself, and the rule compares it with its own bound.

intentions.meaning: The source's current plan for the road user includes a left turn at the target region.

applicability: x is a vehicle (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) and enters intersection i (st.intersection) at this observation (drv.motion.entering_region x i) from an approach carrier c it occupies at this observation (rel.occupies x c, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c i). Device exception (s6): the duty does not apply where some dev.traffic_signal, dev.stop_sign or dev.yield_sign governs i or c (dev.governs) at this observation; this exception is suspended where NRS_484B_250_4_o1 applies to x here (ruleApplies NRS_484B_250_4_o1 {x -> x}: an entry under an inoperative signal). Where x occupies several carriers entering i and the verdict differs between them, which governs is unknown.
obligation: At this entry no vehicle y other than x (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) occupies i having entered it from a different highway: y occupies i (rel.occupies y i) and, read through a past operator from this observation, has occupied i at every observation since its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region y i), at which entry observation y occupied a carrier c2 (st.travel_region, rel.occupies y c2) with st.lane_enters c2 i that lies on a highway h2 (st.highway, st.on_way c2 h2) on which c does not lie (st.on_way c h2 false). Where y's entry into i is not observed (it lies before the recording), whether y entered from a different highway is unknown. Pair exception (s7 to s9): a y is excluded where c and c2 have opposed designated directions (drv.road.opposed_directions c c2 with p.opposed_carriers_cosine) and x or y intends a left turn at i (intent int.left_turn x i, or intent int.left_turn y i) or is making one (drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry of x or of y and i, with step p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph, at least p.turn_recognition_angle).

narrowings.why: 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.
The yield is judged at x's entry into the intersection: an entry while a vehicle from a different highway is in it is the failure to yield.

'official' is read through the device's presence; the devices that control an intersection are read as traffic signals, stop signs and yield signs governing the intersection or the subject's approach (a marking or a warning sign alone controls no right-of-way there).

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: No device governs i or its approaches. The recording begins with both vehicles on their approach carriers. Vehicle y enters i from carrier c2 on highway h2 (its entry is recorded); x, on carrier c on highway h (c not on h2, directions not opposed), enters i while y still occupies i.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but x waits on c until y has left i and enters i as the only road user in the scene.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A dev.stop_sign governs c; signals are absent; x enters i while y occupies i.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, with both entries inside the recording, but rel.occupies is not observed, so neither x's entry nor y's presence in i is decided.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A dev.traffic_signal governing i is dev.inoperative (NRS_484B_250_4_o1 applies); y entered i (recorded) from a different highway; x enters i while y occupies it.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: At a skewed junction, y entered i (recorded) through c2 on another highway whose designated direction is opposed to c's, and int.left_turn y i is declared; x enters while y is in i: the pair is excepted.

segmentation.text: The driver of a vehicle
within an intersection
intending to turn to the left
shall yield the right-of-way
to any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction
which is within the intersection
or so close thereto as to constitute an immediate hazard,
but such driver, having so yielded
and having given a signal
when and as required,
may make such left turn
and the drivers of all other vehicles
approaching the intersection from the opposite direction
shall yield the right-of-way
to the vehicle making the left turn.

elements.justification: 'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'the driver' is read through its controlled motion.

'within an intersection': rel.occupies 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region' of a st.intersection. The carrier x occupied at its latest entry into the intersection (drv.motion.entering_region 'its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before', read through a past operator while x has stayed in the intersection since), whose entrance end is that intersection (st.lane_enters, st.travel_region), fixes its approach direction for s5. st.lane_enters is not a stand-in for presence in the intersection, which rel.occupies reads.

'shall yield the right-of-way' (DEF-NRS-484A-210 'the right ... to proceed ... in preference'): a driver already within the intersection proceeds in preference by making its left turn; yielding is not turning left (drv.motion.turning_left 'it is moving ... and its yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate, deg/s, left positive) exceeds yaw_floor') while a vehicle owed precedence is present. The concept does not tell a turn from a bend; the place is the intersection the node binds.

'any vehicle' is the admitted aggregate. 'approaching from the opposite direction' is read, as rel.oncoming's 'not a stand-in' clause directs, through the carriers: y's approach carrier of the intersection (one it occupies outside the intersection, or the one it occupied at its latest entry into it, drv.motion.entering_region) has a designated direction opposed to that of x's approach carrier (drv.road.opposed_directions 'the dot product of their designated directions ... is below minus opposed_cosine').
'which is within the intersection': rel.occupies of y and the intersection x is in.

operationalizations.standard: so close to the intersection as to constitute an immediate hazard
operationalizations.convention: Gap acceptance (HCM critical headway): an approaching vehicle outside the intersection is an immediate hazard where its ground distance to the intersection (st.region_geometry 'the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it') is at most its speed (kin.speed) times p.immediate_hazard_gap, so the bound moves with both proximity and speed.

intentions.meaning: The source's current plan for the road user includes a left turn at the target region.

applicability: x is a vehicle (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) within intersection i (st.intersection, rel.occupies x i) and, read through a past operator, has occupied i at every observation since its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region x i), at which entry observation x occupied an approach carrier c (st.travel_region, rel.occupies x c, st.lane_enters c i); and the source declares at this observation that x intends a left turn at i (intent int.left_turn x i). Where x's entry into i lies before the recording, the duty is unknown; where x occupied several carriers entering i at that entry and the verdict differs between them, which governs is unknown.
obligation: x is not turning left (drv.motion.turning_left x with p.speed_resolution and p.yaw_rate_resolution) at this observation if some vehicle y other than x (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) approaches from the opposite direction and is within i or so close to i as to be an immediate hazard: either (a) y occupies i and, read through a past operator, has occupied i at every observation since its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region y i), at which entry observation y occupied a carrier c2 (rel.occupies y c2, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c2 i) with drv.road.opposed_directions c c2 (p.opposed_carriers_cosine); or (b) y occupies an approach carrier c2 of i (rel.occupies y c2, st.lane_enters c2 i) with drv.road.opposed_directions c c2, y does not occupy i, and st_region_geometry_distance y i is at most kin_speed y times p.immediate_hazard_gap. Where y's entry into i is not observed, whether (a) holds for y is unknown.

narrowings.why: 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.
Yielding by a driver already within the intersection is read as not turning left while the opposing vehicle is present; creeping straight ahead is not read as a failure to yield.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: The recording begins with x on c upstream of i; x enters i through c (recorded) and int.left_turn x i is declared; vehicle y on c2 (opposed to c, st.lane_enters c2 i) is 20 m from i at 15 m/s; x moves at 4 m/s with kin.yaw_rate 15 deg/s.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As forbid up to x's entry, but x waits halted in i until y has passed, then turns left (kin.yaw_rate 15 deg/s, 4 m/s) as the only road user in the scene.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: x enters i through c (recorded) and occupies i; the source declares int.left_turn x i false (x goes straight).

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, with x's entry recorded, but kin.yaw_rate of x is not observed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: Vehicle y occupies i, having entered (recorded) through c2 opposed to c; x, in i after a recorded entry through c with int.left_turn x i declared, turns left (moving, kin.yaw_rate 12 deg/s).

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: Vehicle y on c2 opposed to c is 200 m from i at 15 m/s; x, in i after a recorded entry through c with int.left_turn x i declared, turns left.

segmentation.text: The driver of a vehicle
within an intersection
intending to turn to the left
shall yield the right-of-way
to any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction
which is within the intersection
or so close thereto as to constitute an immediate hazard,
but such driver, having so yielded
and having given a signal
when and as required,
may make such left turn
and the drivers of all other vehicles
approaching the intersection from the opposite direction
shall yield the right-of-way
to the vehicle making the left turn.

elements.justification: The turning vehicle y is of the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'the driver' is read through its controlled motion.
'within an intersection': rel.occupies 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region' of y and the st.intersection x approaches.

'having given a signal': sig.turn_indicator state left ('the signal that precedes a manoeuvre') or sig.hand_signal meaning left ('a driver's or rider's arm signal'), at some observation since y last came onto its approach carrier c2 (drv.motion.entering_region y c2: 'its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before'), c2 being the carrier (st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c2 i) y occupied at its latest entry into the intersection, y having occupied c2 or the intersection at every observation since. Neither signal is a stand-in for the turn itself, which s11 reads.

'may make such left turn': y is making it, turning left now (drv.motion.turning_left: moving, kin.yaw_rate left positive above resolution) or having turned left since entering the intersection by at least the turn recognition angle (drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry 'the signed heading change of road user x since its footprint last began to overlap region r').
'the drivers of all other vehicles': x, any vehicle of the admitted aggregate other than the turning one, read through its controlled motion.

'approaching the intersection': x occupies an approach carrier c (st.lane_enters 'the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end') and its yield is decided at its entry (drv.motion.entering_region). 'from the opposite direction' relative to the turning vehicle: c and the carrier y occupied at its latest entry into the intersection (drv.motion.entering_region y i, read through a past operator) have opposed designated directions (drv.road.opposed_directions), as rel.oncoming's 'not a stand-in' clause directs.
'shall yield the right-of-way' (DEF-NRS-484A-210): x does not enter the intersection while the turning vehicle is owed precedence.
'the vehicle making the left turn': the vehicle y (admitted aggregate) in the intersection that s11 reads as making the turn.

intentions.meaning: The source's current plan for the road user includes a left turn at the target region.

residues.why: 'when and as required' refers to the signalling requirements of a law outside this corpus (no bracketed id resolves it); the signal itself is read on s9.

applicability: x is a vehicle (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) and enters intersection i (st.intersection) at this observation (drv.motion.entering_region x i) from an approach carrier c it occupies at this observation (rel.occupies x c, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c i).
obligation: At this entry no vehicle y other than x (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) is making a left turn in i under the words' conditions: y occupies i and, read through a past operator, has occupied i at every observation since its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region y i), at which entry observation y occupied a carrier c2 (rel.occupies y c2, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c2 i) with drv.road.opposed_directions c c2 (p.opposed_carriers_cosine); the source declares int.left_turn y i; y is making the turn (drv.motion.turning_left y with p.speed_resolution and p.yaw_rate_resolution, or drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry y i with step p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph at least p.turn_recognition_angle); y has so yielded (rule NRS_484B_253_o1 {x -> y} complied with at every observation since y's latest entry into i); and y has given a signal (sig.turn_indicator left, or sig.hand_signal left) at some observation since y last came onto c2 (drv.motion.entering_region y c2), y having occupied c2 or i at every observation since. Where y's entry into i or onto c2 is not observed, the conditions that turn on it are unknown.

narrowings.why: 'the driver' of the turning vehicle is read through its controlled motion.
'the drivers' are read through the vehicles' controlled motion.
The yield is judged at x's entry into the intersection while the turning vehicle is in it.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: The recording begins with y on a carrier upstream of c2; y comes onto c2 and signals with sig.turn_indicator left on c2, int.left_turn y i declared, enters i through c2 (recorded), waits in i while no opposing vehicle is near, and now turns left (kin.yaw_rate 15 deg/s, 4 m/s); x on c (opposed to c2) enters i.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: x waits on c and enters i after y has left it, as the only road user in i.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: x drives along a road segment and enters no intersection.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, with y's arrival on c2 and its entry into i recorded, but neither sig.turn_indicator nor sig.hand_signal of y is observed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but y's sig.turn_indicator is off and sig.hand_signal no_signal at every observation: y gave no signal, and x owes it no precedence under this duty.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but y began its turn while x was 15 m from i at 15 m/s on c, so NRS_484B_253_o1 was not complied with by y: y has not so yielded.

segmentation.text: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal:
When proper signs have been erected,
the driver of a vehicle
shall stop or yield
at a clearly marked stop line
or, if there is none, before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection
or, if there is none, then at the point nearest the intersection
where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the through highway.
After having stopped or, in the event of a yield sign, slowed or stopped,
the driver shall yield the right-of-way
to other vehicles which have entered the intersection from such through highway
or which are approaching so closely on such through highway as to constitute an immediate hazard during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection.

elements.justification: As in NRS_484B_257_1_o1: x as a member of the admitted traffic aggregate; a dev.human_direction ('a person directing traffic') with role police_officer, or a dev.traffic_signal not dev.inoperative ('showing no valid indication'), governing x's approach carrier or the intersection (dev.governs 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls ... or an intersection').
As in NRS_484B_257_1_o1: a dev.stop_sign or dev.yield_sign governing x's approach carrier or the intersection, at x's entry (drv.motion.entering_region).
'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate; 'the driver' is read through its controlled motion.

'shall yield the right-of-way' (DEF-NRS-484A-210 'to proceed ... in preference to another vehicle'): x does not enter the intersection (drv.motion.entering_region over rel.occupies) while a through-highway vehicle is owed precedence.

'other vehicles' are the admitted aggregate. 'which have entered the intersection from such through highway': y occupies the intersection (rel.occupies) and has occupied it at every observation since its latest entry into it (drv.motion.entering_region 'its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before', read through a past operator), at which entry y occupied a carrier (st.travel_region) whose entrance end is the intersection (st.lane_enters) and that lies on the through highway (st.on_way 'the public way ... a structure region lies on', of kind st.highway) on which x's approach carrier does not lie.

operationalizations.standard: approaching so closely on the through highway as to constitute an immediate hazard during the time the driver is moving across or within the intersection
operationalizations.convention: Gap acceptance (HCM critical headway for a minor-street crossing or turn): a vehicle on an approach carrier of the intersection lying on the through highway (rel.occupies, st.lane_enters, st.on_way), outside the intersection, is an immediate hazard where its ground distance to the intersection (st.region_geometry) is at most its speed (kin.speed) times p.immediate_hazard_gap; the critical gap stands for the time the subject needs to move across or within the intersection, and the bound moves with the other vehicle's proximity and speed.

applicability: As NRS_484B_257_1_o1: x is a vehicle entering intersection i at this observation (drv.motion.entering_region x i) through an approach carrier c it occupies (rel.occupies x c, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c i); a dev.stop_sign or dev.yield_sign governs c or i; x, a member of traffic (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic), is not controlled by a dev.human_direction with role police_officer or a dev.traffic_signal that is not dev.inoperative governing c or i. And NRS_484B_257_1_o1 is complied with for x at this observation (rule NRS_484B_257_1_o1 {x -> x}): that rule being engaged at exactly this entry, its compliance is the fact the words refer to, that x stopped, or under a yield sign slowed or stopped, on this approach.
obligation: At this entry, for every highway h2 (st.highway) on which i lies and c does not (st.on_way i h2; st.on_way c h2 false), no vehicle y other than x (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) either (1) occupies i (rel.occupies y i) and, read through a past operator, has occupied i at every observation since its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region y i), at which entry observation y occupied a carrier c2 (rel.occupies y c2, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c2 i) that lies on h2 (st.on_way c2 h2); or (2) occupies an approach carrier c2 of i lying on h2 (rel.occupies y c2, st.lane_enters c2 i, st.on_way c2 h2), does not occupy i, and st_region_geometry_distance y i is at most kin_speed y times p.immediate_hazard_gap. Where y's entry into i is not observed, whether (1) holds for y is unknown.

narrowings.why: Control of traffic is read as control of x's own approach or intersection; officer and signal presence are read as their status.
'proper signs' are read through the presence of a stop or yield sign.
'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.
The yield is judged at x's entry into the intersection.

'during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection' is read through the critical gap, not through a prediction of x's own crossing time; 'such through highway' is a highway the intersection lies on and x's signed approach does not.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: dev.stop_sign governs c; x halts at the stop line marking c, then enters i while vehicle y on approach carrier c2 of the crossing highway h2 is 25 m from i at 15 m/s.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but x enters i as the only road user in the scene.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: No sign governs c or i; x enters i.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but kin.speed is not observed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: x halts at its stop line and enters i while vehicle y, whose entry into i through c2 on h2 is recorded, occupies i.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but x never halted or slowed on the approach (NRS_484B_257_1_o1 not complied with): this duty does not arise.

segmentation.text: Where the signal is a steady red with a green turn arrow:
A person driving a motorcycle, moped or
trimobile
or riding a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter
facing the signal
may proceed straight through or turn in the direction opposite that indicated by the green turn arrow
if:

(1) The person stops before entering the crosswalk on the nearest side of the intersection where the sign or pavement marking indicates where the stop must be made or, in the absence of any such crosswalk, sign or marking, before entering the intersection;

(2) The person waits for two complete cycles of the lights or lighted arrows of the applicable official traffic-control device and the signal does not change because of a malfunction or because the signal failed to detect the presence of the motorcycle, moped, trimobile, bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter;
(3) No other device at the place prohibits the turn, if applicable;
and
(4) The person yields the right-of-way
to pedestrians lawfully within an adjacent crosswalk and to other traffic lawfully using the intersection.

elements.justification: dev.traffic_signal: "a signal head; state ∈ {... circular_red, ... green_arrow(dir) ...}" and "several states may be displayed at once": a steady red with a green turn arrow is circular_red displayed together with green_arrow(dir), dir left or right. No 'not a stand-in' clause applies.

The admitted aggregates DEF-NRS-484A-135::motorcycle ("every motor vehicle equipped with a seat or saddle for the use of the driver and designed to travel on not more than three wheels in contact with the ground") and DEF-NRS-484A-125::moped ("a motor-driven scooter, motor-driven cycle or similar vehicle"), claimed by id and never expanded. 'A person driving' names who controls the machine, read through its controlled motion (observable_reading agency).

The admitted aggregates DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle ("a device propelled by human power upon which a person may ride"), DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle ("a device upon which a person may ride, having two or three wheels") and DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter ("a vehicle with handlebars and an electric motor"). 'riding' is read through the machine's controlled motion (observable_reading agency).

Facing the signal is the signal governing the approach the person entered through: dev.governs ("the travel regions whose traffic the device controls ... or an intersection") on the carrier c (st.travel_region) with st.lane_enters(c, i) ("the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end") that x occupied (rel.occupies) at the observation of its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region: "its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before"), read through a past operator, or on i itself. dev.governs is 'not a stand-in' for a position and is not used as one.

Proceeding through the intersection is the passage from x's entry (drv.motion.entering_region: "its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before") to its leaving (drv.motion.leaving_region). Straight through or a turn opposite the arrow is read at the leaving by drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry ("The signed heading change of road user x since its footprint last began to overlap region r, in degrees, left positive", from kin.yaw_rate): straight where its size stays below the turn recognition angle, opposite where it reaches that angle on the side away from the arrow.

'stops', a stop required, takes DEF-NRS-484A-255 ("complete cessation from movement"): drv.motion.halted (kin.speed at or below the resolution). The places: the pavement marking indicating where the stop must be made is a st.stop_line ("the transverse line marking where vehicles halt for a device") recorded as marking x's approach carrier c (st.entrance_of: "exactly that carrier's entrance, the line or crossing a vehicle approaching through that carrier halts at or before"); the crosswalk on the nearest side is a st.crosswalk recorded as marking c; failing both, the entrance end of c at the st.intersection (st.lane_enters). Before entering is read along c's designated direction (prim.region_offset_along) with the distance to the place (st.region_geometry) within the stop-point tolerance, and the footprint not yet overlapping the crosswalk or the intersection (rel.occupies). st.intersection is 'not a stand-in' for a crosswalk or a stop line: each place is read on its own.

residues.why: Every trimobile, a motor vehicle with a seat designed to travel on three wheels, is already a member of the motorcycle aggregate claimed on span c2, whose definition takes "every motor vehicle equipped with a seat or saddle for the use of the driver and designed to travel on not more than three wheels in contact with the ground": the duty is the same whether or not the word is read.

vehicular traffic
facing the signal
may enter the intersection
only to make the movement indicated by the green turn arrow,
but must yield the right-of-way
to pedestrians lawfully within an adjacent crosswalk and to other traffic lawfully using the intersection.
Drivers turning in the direction of the arrow are thereby advised that so long as the turn arrow is illuminated, oncoming or opposing traffic simultaneously faces a steady red signal.

elements.justification: dev.traffic_signal: "a signal head; state ∈ {circular_green, circular_yellow, circular_red, green_arrow(dir), ...}" and "several states may be displayed at once": a steady red with a green turn arrow is a head displaying circular_red together with green_arrow(dir), dir left or right. 'The signal' is the head tied to the subject's approach in span b4. No 'not a stand-in' clause applies.

'traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic ("pedestrians, ridden or herded animals, vehicles and other conveyances either singly or together using any highway for purposes of travel"). The law's own qualifier 'vehicular' leaves out the members that are not conveyances: pedestrians ("a person afoot, a person in a manual or motorized wheelchair", the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian, which the rule requires the subject not to carry) and ridden or herded animals, for which the ontology has no class and nothing is read. Cycles and scooters stay in, as 'other conveyances'; paragraph (b) is written as an exception for them, which confirms they are vehicular traffic here.

Facing the signal is the signal governing the approach the subject entered through. dev.governs: "the travel regions whose traffic the device controls ... or an intersection, read as control of the junction itself"; st.lane_enters: "the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end". The approach carrier c (st.travel_region) is the one x occupied (rel.occupies) at the observation of its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region: "its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before"), read through a past operator, with st.lane_enters(c, i); the signal governs c or i. dev.governs is 'not a stand-in' for a position and is not used as one.

drv.motion.entering_region: "Road user x enters structure region r at the observation: its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before"; r is the st.intersection, "the region where two roadways meet".

The movement made through the intersection is read at x's leaving of it (drv.motion.leaving_region: "its footprint overlapped r (rel.occupies) at the observation before and does not overlap it at the observation") by drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry: "The signed heading change of road user x since its footprint last began to overlap region r, in degrees, left positive", integrated from kin.yaw_rate. A left arrow indicates a change of at least the turn recognition angle to the left, a right arrow one to the right. The concept is 'not' a turn by itself; the rule compares it with its own bound.

residues.why: An advisory to drivers turning with the arrow about what opposing traffic faces at the same time; it permits, requires and forbids nothing, and no rule reads it.

applicability: x carries ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic and does not carry ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian; at the observation x leaves an intersection i (drv.motion.leaving_region(x, i)); read through a past operator from that leaving, x occupied i at every observation from its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region(x, i)) to the one before the leaving, and at that entry observation x occupied a carrier c (st.travel_region, rel.occupies(x, c)) with st.lane_enters(c, i) while a traffic signal s that governs c or i (dev.governs) displayed circular_red together with green_arrow(d), d left or right. Where the entry lies before the recording the applicability is unknown. Not engaged where NRS_484B_307_9b_o1 applies to x (composition, exception).
obligation: At that leaving observation the heading change of x since that entry (drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry(x, i) with step p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph) shows the movement a green arrow displayed at the entry indicates: at least p.turn_recognition_angle where d is left, at most minus p.turn_recognition_angle where d is right. Where arrows of both directions were displayed, the movement either indicates complies.

narrowings.why: The movement indicated by the arrow is read as the side and the size of the heading change through the intersection, judged when the subject leaves it: a passage turning at least the turn recognition angle toward the arrow's side complies, whatever lane it exits into.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: x (ru.motor_vehicle), recorded from upstream, enters intersection i from lane c that a signal s governs; s displays circular_red with green_arrow(left) at the entry; x crosses i and leaves it with a heading change since entry well inside p.turn_recognition_angle (straight through).

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The same entry under circular_red with green_arrow(left); x leaves i with a heading change since entry above p.turn_recognition_angle to the left.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: s displays circular_green at x's entry into i; x crosses straight through.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: x, recorded from upstream, enters i from lane c and crosses straight through, but the source does not observe s's state at the entry.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: x is a ru.bicycle; it enters i under circular_red with green_arrow(left) and leaves straight through: paragraph (b) applies (NRS_484B_307_9b_o1 engaged), so this duty does not.

segmentation.text: Where the signal is a steady red with a green turn arrow:
Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (b) [NRS-484B-307-9b],
vehicular traffic
facing the signal
may enter the intersection
only to make the movement indicated by the green turn arrow,
but must yield the right-of-way
to pedestrians lawfully within an adjacent crosswalk and to other traffic lawfully using the intersection.
Drivers turning in the direction of the arrow are thereby advised that so long as the turn arrow is illuminated, oncoming or opposing traffic simultaneously faces a steady red signal.

elements.justification: dev.traffic_signal: "a signal head; state ∈ {circular_green, circular_yellow, circular_red, green_arrow(dir), ...}" and "several states may be displayed at once": a steady red with a green turn arrow is a head displaying circular_red together with green_arrow(dir), dir left or right. No 'not a stand-in' clause applies.

'traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic ("pedestrians, ridden or herded animals, vehicles and other conveyances"). The qualifier 'vehicular' leaves out pedestrians (DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian, "a person afoot", which the subject must not carry) and ridden or herded animals, which have no class atom; cycles and scooters stay in as 'other conveyances'.

Facing the signal is the signal governing the approach the subject entered through: dev.governs ("the travel regions whose traffic the device controls ... or an intersection") on the carrier c (st.travel_region) with st.lane_enters(c, i) ("the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end") that x occupied (rel.occupies) at the observation of its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region: "its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before"), read through a past operator, or on i itself.
drv.motion.entering_region: "its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before", r the st.intersection.

The parties yielded to. 'pedestrians' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian ("a person afoot, a person in a manual or motorized wheelchair"); 'within an adjacent crosswalk' is the pedestrian's footprint overlapping (rel.occupies) a st.crosswalk ("marked crossing, or the unmarked prolongation of sidewalks at an intersection") adjacent to i: a crosswalk recorded as marking the entrance of a carrier entering i (st.entrance_of: "the carrier whose entrance into an intersection a stop line or a crosswalk marks"; st.lane_enters). Distance is not used for adjacency. 'other traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic, every member other than x; 'using the intersection' is its footprint overlapping i (rel.occupies).

operationalizations.standard: yield the right-of-way: not proceeding where the parties' "direction, speed and proximity" "give rise to the danger of a crash unless one grants precedence to the other" (DEF-NRS-484A-210)
operationalizations.convention: Gap-acceptance and surrogate-safety convention: the subject grants precedence where it does not proceed (it is not moving, drv.motion.moving) while a party is in danger of a crash with it; that danger is their predicted closest approach under constant velocities, within the critical gap, coming nearer than the conflict radius, so direction, speed and proximity all enter the prediction by their degree.

residues.why: An advisory to drivers turning with the arrow about what opposing traffic faces at the same time; it permits, requires and forbids nothing, and no rule reads it.

applicability: x carries ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic and does not carry ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian; at the observation x occupies an intersection i (rel.occupies(x, i)) and, read through a past operator, has occupied i at every observation since its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region(x, i)), at which entry observation x occupied a carrier c (st.travel_region, rel.occupies(x, c)) with st.lane_enters(c, i) while a traffic signal s that governs c or i (dev.governs) displayed circular_red together with green_arrow(d), d left or right. Where the entry lies before the recording the applicability is unknown. Not engaged where NRS_484B_307_9b_o1 applies to x (composition, exception).
obligation: Where x is moving at the observation (drv.motion.moving with p.speed_resolution): for every road user p carrying ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian that occupies a crosswalk w recorded as marking the entrance of some carrier c2 entering i (st.entrance_of(w, c2), st.lane_enters(c2, i)), and for every road user u other than x carrying ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic that occupies i, it is not the case that x and that road user approach within p.immediate_hazard_gap (prim.closest_approach_within) with a closest-approach centre distance (prim.closest_approach_distance) below p.conflict_clearance.

narrowings.why: 'lawfully' is not read: every pedestrian in such a crosswalk and every other member of traffic inside the intersection is yielded to. 'an adjacent crosswalk' is read as a crosswalk recorded as marking the entrance of a carrier entering the intersection; a crosswalk across the exit of a one-way leg marks no entrance and is not read.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: x (ru.motor_vehicle), recorded from upstream, entered i under circular_red with green_arrow(left) and is turning left, moving; a ru.pedestrian occupies the crosswalk that marks the entrance of the carrier on the leg x turns into, and prim.closest_approach_within holds over p.immediate_hazard_gap with a prim.closest_approach_distance below p.conflict_clearance.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: x, recorded from upstream, enters i under circular_red with green_arrow(left) and turns left with no other road user in the scene.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: x enters i while s displays circular_green.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: x, recorded from upstream, moves through i with a pedestrian approaching in a crosswalk at the entrance of the leg x turns into, but the source does not observe s's state at x's entry.
